purpose: W2-A: canonical physical inventory identities, pinned exact commodity quantities and PostgreSQL atomic reservation/release across lots sharing one position.
authorization: Owner instruction to continue PC-CROP on 2026-09-05 with existing push/PR/merge authorization; implements the merged W2-A acceptance plan. Authority must be merged separately before implementation.
requiredInvariants: Registration, role eligibility and the accounting lock #4321 remain unchanged.
Use canonical CommodityProfile versions and existing Auction/Deal references; no second Deal or provider engine.
Manual/imported declarations remain DECLARED and cannot manufacture confirmed quantity, ownership, custody or verified evidence.
Versioned availability distinguishes exclusive stock buckets from cumulative lifecycle counters; all quantities use exact integers and pinned units.
PostgreSQL commands serialize one physical position at READ COMMITTED; direct restricted-role DML cannot bypass command evidence or quantity limits.
Tenant and organization authority comes from current database membership; revoked authority cannot replay or mutate commands.
CAS, payload-bound idempotency, audit, event and outbox commit atomically; immutable snapshots retain policy and source-state versions.
No mandatory paid dependencies, external partner messages or production mutations.
acceptance: Concurrent reservations on two canonical lots sharing one physical position never exceed availability.
Cross-tenant and same-tenant cross-organization reads/commands are denied under restricted principals.
Exact replay, conflicting replay, stale versions, release races and direct SQL bypass attempts are tested.
Audit, event and outbox failure leave no partial state or acknowledged missing command.
Pinned quantity precision/conversions, forward migrations, zero schema drift and backup/restore are proven.
remainingTerminalBoundary: All inventory lifecycle transitions, genealogy, independent custody/title/evidence and trust policy remain later W2 slices.
Existing Lot/Offer/Deal writers must all consume inventory authority before DOUBLE_SELL_PROTECTION terminal credit.
Honest declaration/warning/acknowledgement UI and REG.RU runtime acceptance are still required.
